target.value: one magical +1 suit of armor, shield, or weapon

description.summary: This spell summons a magical +1 suit of armor, shield, or weapon
description.value: This spell summons a magical +1 suit of armor, shield, or weapon. The item disappears and the spell ends if the item is farther than 100 feet from the summoner. The item summoned by this spell appears without any ammunition, cannot be any form of artillery or siege weapon nor can it be bigger than medium size. The items summoned cannot be made out of Special Materials .
